This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Groff Zugga]]<ref name="EIR" /> and [[Groff Haugg]] were members of this species.<ref name="BH" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was distinguished by their large builds and either [[Color/Legends|orange]] and yellow<ref name="EIR" /> or purple, tan, and pink.<ref name="BH" /> They possessed large [[Mouth/Legends|lips]] and upturned [[Nose/Legends|noses]] that were both pink in coloration, as well as orange [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] with black pupils. The species possessed a pair of dark, curved, spiral [[Bone/Legends|horns]] extending up and back from the tops of their heads, and could grow a patch of brown<ref name="EIR" /> or purple<ref name="BH" /> [[Hair/Legends|hair]] in between them. Members of this species possessed four [[Breast/Legends|breasts]], the smaller pair flanked by a larger pair.<ref name="EIR" />

==Society and culture==
One member of this species, [[Groff Zugga]], served as leader of the [[Galactic Spice Mining Guild]] and guild [[Boss/Legends|boss]] on the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] mining [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]]<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC1">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The racing season presented in the [[Star Wars video games|game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]'' must have taken place during this year due to the appearances of [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], which correspond to ''The Phantom Menace''.</ref> occasionally hosting [[Podracing/Legends|Podraces]] on the planet, including the [[Mon Gazza Speedway/Legends|Mon Gazza Speedway]], [[Spice Mine Run]], and the [[Zugga Challenge/Legends|Zugga Challenge]].<ref name="Prima" /> That same year,<ref name="TERC">''Star Wars: Bounty Hunter'' is set immediately after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> another member of this species, [[Groff Haugg]], served as owner of [[Haugg Nerf Industries]] while doubling as a [[Death stick/Legends|death stick]] trafficker associated with the [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora]] [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] cult.<ref name="BH" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[1999]]<ref name="IGN">{{WebCite|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/1999/05/18/star-wars-hits-the-shelves|text=Star Wars Hits The Shelves|author=IGN Staff|date=1999-05-18|work=[[Wikipedia:IGN|IGN]]|archivedate=20121121210047}}</ref> video game [[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']].<ref name="EIR" /> The [[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Bounty Hunter:'' Prima's Official Strategy Guide]] erroneously depicts Groff Haugg as a member of the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] species.<ref name="Prima2">[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Bounty Hunter:'' Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>
